en: Colorized panoramic view of a town at the base of a large, tree‑covered hill or mountain. Low buildings with red and light roofs are scattered among many trees and fields in the foreground. Dirt roads and open countryside occupy the very front of the image. At the top right there is printed text in a serif font that appears to be the caption of the postcard.
